terra.problem: The forgotten timer comparison has no clear connection to the beast losing its wings.
The text does not say where the beast will or will not go to rest.
The text does not say that nothing is dragged anywhere or establish that everything happens where the beast stands.
“In a hurry” adds a speed the text does not give.
The horn speaks words of arrogance, but the text does not say it is loud.
Aaron, Nadab and Abihu are named without an introduction explaining who they are.
The text does not say the beast has no chance to kneel.
The cookie-box comparison does not make clear sense and makes the scope of the kingdom the subject of the joke.
The comparison conflates the beasts' extension of life with the duration of a kingdom. Their dominion was removed.
The removal of the beasts' dominion does not establish the claim that they do not share in this kingdom.
Saying Daniel prayed toward Jerusalem once suggests a single occasion, but Daniel 6:10 says he prayed three times a day.
“So you can't miss it” assigns a reason for the repetition that the text does not give.
The passage says the horn wages war against the saints; it does not explicitly say the other beasts are not in the fight.

Daniel 8:16 names Gabriel and records a command to explain the vision, but does not itself identify him as an angel or show him explaining it. The explanation needs supporting references for those facts.
“Neither will you” tells the baker what they will do and sounds unnecessarily controlling.
Noah is named without a brief introduction.
“The words are different on purpose” assigns an intention that the text does not state.
